description: Companies whose active UCC-1 liens lapse within 12 months (Renewal Radar). UCC liens expire after 5 years — the incumbent lender must re-file or lose priority, so each approaching lapse is a refinancing window with a date on it. For lenders, MCA/ISO, and equipment finance. California + Colorado coverage (CO refreshed daily). No API key required.
name: get_refinancing_windows
